title: Implicitize a sparse rational surface parametrization

source.citation: Nicolas Botbol and Marc Dohm, A package for computing implicit equations of parametrizations from toric surfaces, arXiv:1001.1126

translation.notes: Rather than reconstructing the paper's toric approximation-complex matrix, this case homogenizes the graph with a scale variable and eliminates the three parameters. The unique degree-six result matches all 41 printed coefficients after correcting two visibly nonhomogeneous exponents in the displayed formula.
